origin.body: Our roots run deep in Desa Pujungan, Kecamatan Pupuan, Tabanan — a quiet mountain village in Bali where cool mist, forest shade, and highland altitude shape the character of every bean we carefully roast.
roasting.heading: Slowly roasted to perfection.
roasting.spec.roastType.label: Roast Type
roasting.spec.hulling.label: Hulling
roasting.body: Yielding a bold, full-bodied character — rich notes of dark chocolate bitterness and a captivating smoky depth that lingers. Crafted for those who appreciate the art of depth in every cup.
product.arabica.description: Single-origin roasted beans from the highlands — delivering a bright, nuanced cup with a natural sweetness that lingers.
product.robusta.description: High-caffeine, low-acid roasted beans with a rich, earthy depth — the unmistakable backbone of a powerful espresso.
product.blend.description: A masterfully balanced blend — where the brightness of Arabica meets the boldness of Robusta in perfect harmony.
product.blend.customText: Want a different ratio? We craft custom blends to your preference.
product.blend.customMsg: Hi Pavaroma, I'd like to request a custom blend ratio.
contact.heading: Let's Talk Coffee.
contact.body: Whether you're a café, a roaster, or simply someone who loves great coffee — we'd love to hear from you.
whatsapp.label: Chat with us
whatsapp.message: Hi Pavaroma, I'd like to know more about your roasted coffee.
